details: Bitcoin (BTC) experienced a slip below $77,000 on Thursday and showed volatility on Friday, influenced by stronger-than-expected U.S. Producer Price Index (PPI) and Consumer Price Index (CPI) data. This led to increased market expectations for a Federal Reserve rate hike at its September 16 meeting, with odds rising to around 70-85%. The macroeconomic pressures, including surging oil prices and rising Treasury yields, created a risk-off sentiment in the broader crypto market, triggering significant liquidations of leveraged long positions.
title: Bitcoin Dips as Hotter US PPI & CPI Boost Fed Rate Hike Bets

details: The Grayscale Zcash ETF (ZCSH) has seen its Assets Under Management (AUM) exceed $500 million within two weeks of its listing on NYSE Arca, attracting over $70 million in cumulative inflows and a $100 million investment from DCG International. This significant institutional interest, combined with Zcash's privacy-focused features, has driven ZEC's price past $1,200, marking a substantial rally and outperforming many other major cryptocurrencies.
title: Zcash ETF Surpasses $500M AUM, Fueling Price Surge

details: Nasdaq's venture arm has invested $100 million in Payward, the parent company of cryptocurrency exchange Kraken, valuing it at $21 billion. This investment deepens their partnership aimed at developing infrastructure for trading tokenized equities. The collaboration plans to launch Nasdaq Equity Tokens (NETs) by Q2 2027, allowing shares to be held on a blockchain with full voting rights, signaling a significant convergence of traditional finance and blockchain technology.
title: Nasdaq Invests $100M in Kraken to Advance Tokenized Equities

details: Uniswap Labs has launched "StablePair Hook," a new Uniswap v4 dynamic-fee hook designed for stable trading pairs like USDC/USDT. This innovation aims to provide traders with consistent and predictable quotes while allowing liquidity providers to retain more value by adjusting fees based on price deviation from the true rate. The initial pools are live on the Ethereum mainnet, supporting USDC/USDG and USDC/USDT pairs.
title: Uniswap Labs Launches Dynamic-Fee StablePair Hook for v4

details: The Solana network achieved an all-time high in daily token issuance on Wednesday, with more than 263,000 new Solana Program Library (SPL) tokens minted in a single 24-hour period. This figure significantly surpasses the activity seen during the peak of the memecoin cycle in late 2024, indicating a fresh wave of speculative energy and robust network activity, largely driven by launchpads like Pump.fun.
title: Solana Sets New Record with Over 263,000 Tokens Issued in One Day
